verses.text: Ha in Pablo in, schekab' in Jesucristo, yujnhej to icha chi' ix el t'a sk'o'ol Dios. Ha in yet' winh kuk'tak Timoteo, sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun ko carta tik t'ayex yiglesia exxo Dios t'a chonhab' Corinto. Sko tz'ib'anpaxb'at t'ayex he masanil ex yikexxo Dios t'a yol yik Acaya.
Ko gana syak' swach'k'olal ko Mam Dios yet' Kajal Jesucristo t'ayex ta', syak'anpax sjunk'olal.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Dios, haton Smam Kajal Jesucristo, ko Mam ton paxi, tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'ayonh, syak' wal sniwanil ko k'o'ol yujto ko Diosal yaji.

Ayik sja ko ya'elal, ha Dios tz'ak'an sniwanil ko k'o'ol, yik wach' syal pax kak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol heb' tz'ab'an pax sya'il. Icha syutej Dios yak'an sniwanil ko k'o'ol, icha pax chi' skutej kak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol heb'.
Icha wal tz'aj kab'an sya'elal yet' Cristo, icha pax chi' syutej yak'an sniwanil ko k'o'ol.

Yuj chi', icha chi' tzonh aji ayik skab'an sya'il, yik wach' syal kak'an sniwanil he k'o'ol yik tek'an tzeyutej he b'a. Hanhejtona', ayik syak'an sniwanil ko k'o'ol Dios, icha chi' tzonh aji, yik wach' syal kak'an sniwanil he k'o'ol, yuj chi' syal he tek'b'an he b'a eyak'an techaj juntzanh ya'elal ol ak'jok och t'a eyib'anh icha tz'ak'jioch t'a kib'anh a onh tik.
Tek'an skutej ko b'a kak'anoch Dios yipok ko k'o'ol eyu'uj, yujto kojtak to icha tzeyutej eyab'an sya'il ket'ok, icha pax chi' ol aj yak'anpax sniwanil he k'o'ol Dios ket'ok.

Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', sko nib'ej skal t'ayex jantak sya'il ix kab'i ayik ix onh ek' t'a yol yik Asia. Yujto te ya' ix onh ek' ta', ijan maj techajlaj ku'uj. Ix ko na' to ijan wal maj onh kolchajel-laj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Ha ko na'ani to ol onh cham ta'. Icha chi' utab'il onh ta', yik wach' anhej Dios skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol, yujto ha' tz'ak'an pax pitzwok heb' chamnak. Xal onh, maxtzak ko na' tato tzonh kolchaji.

Jab'xonhej wal maj onh cham yuj jun niwan ya'elal chi', haxo Dios onh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, wan onh skolan paxel tiknaik. Hanheja' skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol to ol onh skolelta t'a juntzanh sya'elal chi',
tato tzex kolwaj ket' t'a lesal. Tato tzijtum ex tzex lesalwi ku'uj, hanhejtona' niwan ex ol eyak' yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj swach'k'olal ol yak' t'ayonh.

Tzonh tzalaji, yujto kojtak wal to tojol skutej ko b'eyb'al t'a masanil heb' anima yet' pax t'ayex. Malaj spaltail ko b'eyb'al, yujto skolwaj Dios yet' swach'k'olal t'ayonh. Manh yujok ko jelanil wach' ko b'eyb'al.

Ayik sko tz'ib'anb'at juntzanh carta t'ayex, anhej juntzanh tas tzeyila' yet' juntzanh tas snachajel eyu'uj, a sko tz'ib'ejb'at t'ayex. Tzaxo nachajel jab'ok eyu'uj tas kaji. Yuj chi', swak'och yipok in k'o'ol to ol wach' nachajel eyu'uj to ayik ol jax Kajal Jesús, ol yal he k'echa'anh ku'uj, ich onh pax ta' ol onh k'epaxcha'anh eyu'uj.
Icha chi' wutejnak wak'anoch yipok in k'o'ol. Yuj chi', tzin b'ab'laj ek' ex wila'' yik wach' chael tzin ek' t'ayex t'a elanhchamel in na'ani, haxo he wach' cha'an swach'k'olal Dios.
Ha in na'ani to tzin ek' ex wila'', ichato chi' b'i'an tzin ja t'a Macedonia tik. Haxo tzin meltzaji, tzex ek' wilanxi. Tato icha chi', a ex syal tzex kolwaj t'ayin yik tzin b'atxi t'a Judea.

Ayik ix in na'an juntzanh tik, ¿tom manh chamok ix in na he na'ani? ¿Tom tze na'a to tonhej tzin na juntzanh tik icha sna heb' komon anima? ¿Tom tze na'a, to anhej yet' in ti', hinye, xin chi, palta haxo t'a in pensar wan in na'ani to ma'ay?
Syil Dios, haton tz'elnhejk'och tas syala', a onh tik malaj junelok sko tak'wej ko ti'ok, slajwi chi' skalanxi to manhxo.
Ha in tik, winhaj Silvano yet' winhaj Timoteo ek'nak onh kalel yab'ixal Cristo Jesús Yuninal Dios t'ayex. Ha Cristo chi', malaj junelok yalnak: Hinye, palta haxo t'a spensar yojtak to ma'ay.
Ha tz'ak'an elk'och masanil tas ix yalkan Dios. Yuj chi', a skalan wach' lolonel t'a Dios, skalan amén yuj Cristo Jesús.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an stek'anil he pensar ket'ok, yujto ay onhxo och t'a yol sk'ab' Cristo. Ha Dios ak'jinak kopisio koch schekab'ok.

Ha ak'jinak och jun sello t'ayonh junjun onh, haton Yespíritu. Ha Yespíritu tik sch'oxani to yik onhxo Dios, sch'oxanpax t'ayonh to t'a wal yel ol ko cha juntzanhxo tas yalnak Dios chi' to ol yak' t'ayonh.
Malaj in gana tz'och he kusk'olal wu'uj, yuj chi' majto in ek' t'ayex t'a Corinto chi'. Wal yel swala', syil ko Mam Dios yujto yojtak masanil tas ay t'a in pensar.

Malaj ko gana tzex kak' pural, skalan t'ayex tas tzeyutej eyak'anoch Dios t'a he k'o'ol. Yujto tek'anxo tzeyutej eyak'anoch t'a he k'o'ol. Palta ko gana tzonh kolwaj t'ayex, yik sko wach' ak'ej he na'a, yik wach' ol ja he tzalajk'olal ta'.
